# dependencytrack_workload_identity_provider (Resource)

Manages a Dependency-Track workload identity provider: an external token issuer, such as GitHub Actions, whose tokens service accounts can exchange for Dependency-Track sessions. Which tokens map to which service account is defined by `dependencytrack_workload_identity_binding`. Signing keys come from `jwks` (inline), `jwks_url`, or, for `OIDC` providers when both are unset, the issuer's discovery document. Requires Dependency-Track 5.2 or newer and the `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Trust GitHub Actions OIDC tokens. The signing keys are resolved from the
# issuer's discovery document.
resource "dependencytrack_workload_identity_provider" "github_actions" {
  name     = "github-actions"
  type     = "OIDC"
  issuer   = "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
  audience = "https://dtrack.example.com"
}

# An issuer whose public keys are provided inline
resource "dependencytrack_workload_identity_provider" "internal" {
  name                     = "internal-ci"
  type                     = "OIDC"
  issuer                   = "https://ci.internal.example.com"
  audience                 = "dependency-track"
  jwks                     = file("${path.module}/internal-ci-jwks.json")
  session_lifetime_seconds = 900
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `audience` (String) The value the token's `aud` claim must contain
- `issuer` (String) The expected `iss` claim for `OIDC` providers, or the SPIFFE trust domain (such as `example.org`) for `SPIFFE` providers
- `name` (String) The name of the workload identity provider (max 63 characters)
- `type` (String) The type of issuer: `OIDC` for an OpenID Connect issuer (tokens' `iss` must equal `issuer`), or `SPIFFE` for a SPIFFE trust domain (`sub` must be a SPIFFE ID of that domain)

### Optional

- `jwks` (String) An inline RFC 7517 JSON Web Key Set (JSON string, e.g. from `jsonencode()` or `file()`) holding the issuer's public signing keys. Dependency-Track does not return it, so changes made outside Terraform are only detected through `jwks_key_ids`
- `jwks_url` (String) The `https` URL to fetch the issuer's signing keys from. Conflicts with `jwks`. Leave both unset on an `OIDC` provider to resolve the URL from the issuer's discovery document
- `session_lifetime_seconds` (Number) The lifetime in seconds (60-86400) of sessions created through this provider. Default: `3600`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the workload identity provider (same as `name`)
- `jwks_key_ids` (List of String) The key IDs of the inline key set. Null when the keys are fetched from a URL

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Workload identity providers can be imported using their name. An inline
# jwks cannot be read back.
terraform import dependencytrack_workload_identity_provider.example github-actions
```
